title: Concept: Pug template error returned to a client
description: A Pug template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The error prints the template source lines around the failure, which exposes server-side view code to anyone who triggers it.
applicability: Deployments that render a Pug template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The error prints the template source lines around the failure, which exposes server-side view code to anyone who triggers it.
